hash_rule: SHA256 of UTF-8 seed + LF + prefix + LF + original source_id, no final LF. original source_id is the existing canonical frame identity (e.g. val/000000:17), no remap.
eligibility: Exclude all three existing weak44 frame ids and every origin component containing them
algorithm: Within each prefix sort by (stable_SHA256,source_id). For each of 12 sorted-prefix slots choose first unused component whose selection leaves a complete bipartite matching for all remaining prefix slots. Fail if total matching impossible; no relaxation, replenishment or selection from outputs.
metadata_access: Exact bound SOURCE185 frame/input/role metadata only, role/identity first; inspect q/L/availability or RGB/cache bindings only after TRAIN identity. Weak44 metadata filtered component_role==TRAIN before frame/component values.
future_payload_policy: Only 12 selected original canonical RGB NPY and 12 per-frame INPUT_ONLY NPZ bindings recorded. No binary stat/hash/header/open/decode in this preparation.
